altnames.hhbib_lgcode:
Korapun (Br) so different from Godschalk-Sela and Kimyal-Sela of Kroneman that it must be a different language
Korapun-Kimyal

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 includes the varieties of the Sela valley and those in the Erok and Dagi valleys in the Korupun-Sela [kpq] entry. Although not fully conclusive, (**hh:ew:Godschalk:Sela-Valley**:4) called the two ``distinctly different'' and a comparison of wordlists suggest in (**hh:hvw:Voorhoeve:Irian**, **hh:ew:Godschalk:Sela-Valley**) that they are distinct languages, motivating a separate entry for Erok-Dagi (also called Korapun Kimyal). See also: Korupun-Sela [kpq].
